basis: Brazil audit updated after FP1. Visually reviewed FIA Document 15 page 1: the Stewards impose a five-place drop for George Russell's sixth ICE, to be served at his next race, distinguishing the sanction from Technical Delegate Document 14. Document 16 page 1 records Franco Colapinto at 80.6 km/h against the event's 80 km/h pit-lane limit and fines the BWT Alpine F1 Team EUR 100. Document 18 pages 2-3 lists 13 deleted lap-time entries for ten named drivers at turns 1, 7, 10 and 12; these deletions are not a revised finishing classification. Newly reviewed Document 19 page 2 (issued 6 November at 14:00) orders deletion of the shown FP1 lap times for Franco Colapinto, Alexander Albon, Luke Browning, Rafael Camara and Dino Beganovic after their cars passed through a double-waved-yellow sector; the listed 2:05.129, 1:32.736, 1:33.848, 1:18.760 and OUT LAP entries are lap-time deletions, not a race penalty or revised FP1 classification. The official Formula1.com Practice 1 table was collected with all 22 entrants (Norris 1:11.717, Antonelli +0.082s, Verstappen +0.236s). Rechecked the FIA event listing at 17:00 UTC; Doc 17 classification is discovered separately and the displayed classification comes from the official Formula1.com results source. Existing reviews of Documents 8, 12 and 14 remain in force; Document 12's McLaren four-item declaration and ten nil returns, including its page-3 component diagram, were previously reviewed. Upgrade aims are not measured gains.
